fullBackup.title: Full backup (radio and Meshloom)
fullBackup.help: Everything to rebuild the node: radio identity and settings, contacts, channels and Meshloom settings. Download it before reflashing the radio.
fullBackup.keyWarning: This file holds your radio's private key and other secrets: keep it private.
fullBackup.encryptHelp: Optional. Without the passphrase, nobody can restore the file.
fullBackup.warningNoIdentity: No identity: the radio did not give its private key.
fullBackup.warningIdentityDisabled: No identity: the radio's firmware does not export its private key.
fullBackup.warningRadioDisconnected: Radio not connected: only Meshloom's data is backed up.
fullBackup.warningRadioNotReady: The radio is still starting: this backup holds the Meshloom data only. Try again in a moment.
fullBackup.warningWifiNotStored: The radio stores no Wi-Fi password: the backup holds none.
fullBackup.warningWifiReadFailed: The radio's Wi-Fi credentials could not be read.
fullBackup.warningReadFailed: Some radio settings could not be read and are not in this backup.
fullBackup.downloadedNoIdentity: Full backup downloaded, without the radio's identity: read the notes below.

fullRestore.title: Restore a backup
fullRestore.help: Choose a file: Meshloom shows what will change before writing anything.
fullRestore.invalidFile: This file is not a Meshloom backup.
fullRestore.noIdentity: This backup has no identity: the radio's private key is not in it.
fullRestore.hasWifi: Contains the Wi-Fi credentials stored in the radio.
fullRestore.hasWifiOpenNetwork: Contains the Wi-Fi network stored in the radio, an open network (no password).
fullRestore.hasWifiFlagOnly: Contains whether the radio's Wi-Fi is on, without credentials (the radio stored none).
fullRestore.v1Only: Meshloom data only (older format): the radio is not touched.
fullRestore.botsConverted: The bots ({{names}}) come back as extensions turned off: review them in Settings > Extensions.

identity.no_identity: The radio keeps its own identity.
identity.same: The connected radio already has this identity.
identity.sameNotConnected: Radio not connected: only Meshloom's data is restored. Restore again once the radio is connected.
identity.restores_bound: The connected radio gets the identity this Meshloom belongs to back.
identity.new_database: Radio not connected: only Meshloom's data is restored. When it connects, choose Restore from a backup.
identity.replaces_live: The identity of the connected radio is replaced by this backup's.
identity.replaces_history: The history recorded under another identity is erased.
identity.needs_radio: Connect the radio first: Meshloom cannot check whose history it holds.
identity.conflict: The backup, the radio and this Meshloom have three different identities: it cannot be restored.

fullRestore.identityReplacesLiveConfirm: I understand that the identity of radio {{name}} ({{key}}…) will be replaced and lost unless I backed it up.
fullRestore.identityWipeConfirm: I understand that the history Meshloom recorded under the other identity is erased.
fullRestore.identityWipeOptional: Also erase this Meshloom's history (messages, contacts, telemetry). Otherwise it is kept.
fullRestore.wifiTcpWarning: Meshloom reaches the radio over Wi-Fi: restoring another network would cut it off. Off by default.
fullRestore.wifiOffTcpWarning: Meshloom reaches the radio over Wi-Fi: this backup would turn it off. Off by default.
fullRestore.blePinWarning: This Bluetooth PIN differs from the current one and also replaces Meshloom's. Off by default.
fullRestore.meshloomStepRequired: Channels and contacts are written from the restored Meshloom data: restore it too.
fullRestore.confirm: I understand that this merges into the live database and writes to the radio

codes.radio_rebooting: the radio rebooted to reset its clock
codes.identity_gate_open: the radio identity question is still open
codes.contacts_table_full: the radio's contact table is full
codes.internal_error: unexpected error, see the server logs
codes.radio_contacts_unreadable: the radio's contact table could not be read
codes.wifi_store_partial: the radio may hold only part of the credentials
codes.wifi_store_unverified: the radio did not confirm the credentials
codes.proxy_link: not available through a radio proxy
codes.link_unreliable: the radio link is not reliable enough
codes.tx_power_rejected: the radio refused the transmit power
codes.radio_params_rejected: the radio refused the radio parameters
codes.path_hash_mode_rejected: the radio refused the path hash mode
codes.tuning_rejected: the radio refused the timing parameters
codes.custom_var_rejected: the radio refused at least one variable
codes.default_flood_scope_rejected: the radio refused the flood scope
codes.autoadd_rejected: the radio refused the auto-add rules
codes.cli_pref_rejected: the radio refused at least one setting

fullRestore.rebootRequired: Reboot the radio to apply the restored settings.
fullRestore.rerunHint: Some steps did not run. Run the restore again once the radio is back.
fullRestore.communityReminder: Community membership is not restored: join again if you wish.
fullRestore.identityRecheck: The radio changed since the backup was read: check the summary again.
fullRestore.integrations: Integrations: {{list}}. The ones turned on send as soon as the restore ends.
fullRestore.proxyEnabled: This backup's radio proxy will start, without authentication.
fullRestore.secretStoreUnavailable: The secrets.key file cannot be read or created: check that Meshloom can write to its data folder, or untick Meshloom data.
fullRestore.pushTargets: Your push notifications go to {{list}} as soon as the restore ends.

fileWarnings.private_key_export_disabled: No identity: the radio's firmware did not export its private key.
fileWarnings.private_key_unavailable: The radio did not give its private key: this backup has no identity.
fileWarnings.radio_not_connected: Radio not connected at backup time: Meshloom's data only.
fileWarnings.radio_not_ready: The radio was still starting when this backup was made: it holds the Meshloom data only.
fileWarnings.wifi_not_stored: The radio stored no Wi-Fi password: none is in this backup.
fileWarnings.wifi_read_failed: The radio's Wi-Fi credentials could not be read: they are not in this backup.
fileWarnings.radio_read_failed: Some radio settings could not be read and are not in this backup.

warnings.fanout_reserved: {{value}} is one of Meshloom's own modules: not taken from the file.
warnings.fanout_invalid: Integration {{value}} was not restored: its settings are not valid here.
warnings.bots_converted: The bots ({{value}}) became extensions turned off: review them in Settings > Extensions.
warnings.push_kept_existing: This Meshloom's push keys were kept: turn push on again in the browsers of the backup.
warnings.proxy_port_managed: The radio proxy port is set by the host: the backup's port was not applied.
warnings.proxy_targets_transport: The radio proxy would point at Meshloom's own radio link: it stays disabled.
warnings.tx_power_clamped: The transmit power was lowered to this radio's maximum.
warnings.client_repeat_not_allowed: This radio does not allow client repeat on this frequency: radio parameters written without it.
warnings.flood_scope_not_applied: The flood scope could not be applied to the radio.
warnings.channel_key_invalid: A channel with an invalid key was not written to the radio.
warnings.channel_rejected: The radio refused at least one channel.
warnings.channel_clear_failed: The radio refused to empty at least one unused channel slot.
warnings.channels_over_radio_limit: There are more channels than the radio has slots: the extra ones stay in Meshloom only.
warnings.radio_contacts_unreadable: The radio's contact table could not be read: no contact was written to it.
warnings.contact_load_failed: At least one contact could not be written to the radio.

fullRestore.jobLost: The server restarted during the restore: check the result, then run it again if needed.

radio.exportHelpKeyWarning: The file may hold the radio's private key: keep it private.

errors.backup_invalid: This file is not a valid Meshloom backup.
errors.backup_bad_passphrase: Wrong passphrase, or the file was changed.
errors.backup_bad_envelope: This encrypted backup is damaged or uses unsupported settings.
errors.backup_passphrase_required: This backup is encrypted: enter its passphrase.
errors.backup_passphrase_too_short: The passphrase needs at least 8 characters.
errors.backup_too_large_to_encrypt: Backup too large to encrypt (over 16 MiB): download it without encryption.
errors.backup_identity_invalid: The private key in this backup does not match its identity.
errors.backup_identity_conflict: This backup, the connected radio and this Meshloom all belong to different identities.
errors.backup_identity_replaces_live: Restoring replaces the identity of the connected radio: confirm it first.
errors.backup_identity_wipe_required: The history recorded under another identity must be erased: confirm it first.
errors.backup_use_full_restore: This file is a full backup: restore it from Settings > Database.
errors.backup_secret_store_unavailable: Nothing was restored: secrets.key cannot be read or created. Check that Meshloom can write to its data folder.
errors.backup_restore_job_not_found: This restore is no longer known (the server restarted).
errors.private_key_import_disabled: The radio firmware does not accept importing a private key: the identity cannot be restored.
errors.private_key_import_rejected: The radio refused the private key.
errors.private_key_import_unverified: The radio did not confirm the new identity.
errors.live_identity_changed: The connected radio changed during the restore: nothing was imported.
errors.tx_power_rejected: The radio rejected the transmit power.
errors.radio_params_rejected: The radio rejected the radio parameters.
